overview: This file consists of a single State Department cross-reference sheet, filed under Japanese wireless-telegraph regulations, directing researchers to original paper no. 34205. The referenced document, dated July 1, 1940, concerns a permit for a shortwave radio and indicates that an individual identified in the OCR only as “irw” had been asked to apply for the permit; the sheet also records file numbers 1.3.1.1/1 and 894.741/16.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference sheet for shortwave-radio permit
subfiles.about: The sheet refers researchers to original paper no. 34205 concerning an application for a shortwave-radio permit.
subfiles.summary: This cross-reference sheet records that a permit for the shortwave radio of an unidentified person rendered by the OCR as “irw” was at issue and that the person had been requested to apply for it. It directs the reader to original paper no. 34205, dated July 1, 1940, and gives the associated file numbers 1.3.1.1/1 and 894.741/16. No sender or recipient is supplied.

interest: The sheet is useful chiefly as a recordkeeping artifact: it reveals how documentation concerning radio licensing was cross-filed within the State Department’s decimal filing system. Although it contains little substantive policy information, its reference numbers and date may enable a historian to locate the missing original document and reconstruct administrative oversight of shortwave-radio use in Japan in 1940. The ambiguous OCR form “irw” is especially important to verify against the original image or referenced paper.
